reasons: Cited text supports the compliant status: paragraph 8(h) permits either Party (including Customer/AP) to assign without consent to an affiliate, a purchaser of substantially all relevant assets, or a successor by merger, stock sale or consolidation, and subjects other assignments to a 'not unreasonably withheld' consent standard — squarely the ASSIGN fallback position.

No walk-away trigger exists: there is no blanket bar on Customer assignment, no deemed-assignment language, and the termination provisions in 4(a)-(b) are limited to convenience after the Initial Term, uncured material breach and insolvency, with no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right for Kubient.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was applied (original and rendered paragraphs are identical) and no counterparty comment was proposed; the deterministic successor/affiliate carve-out check passes.

Rationale accurately identifies the party roles and reasonably declines to press the asymmetric preferred formulation given the mutual bargain; this is retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
